compliance_decision:
Compliance Answer: Beneficial ownership information should be obtained when establishing or updating Customer Due Diligence (CDD) records, and it must include sufficient details to identify the beneficial owner(s), their status as natural persons, and how they exercise control. This information needs verification against a reliable third-party source for accuracy and is required to be current whenever ownership changes occur within reasonable timeframes.
2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: PCC-59-Beneficial-ownership.txt (Chunk 8028)
3. Explanation: The regulatory context specifies that beneficial owner information must include sufficient details to identify the natural person(s), their status, and control mechanisms as part of CDD requirements. It emphasizes accuracy through third-party verification and mandates updating this information when ownership changes occur within a reasonable period (6.2., 6.3., 6.4.).
